paragraphs.source_en: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, during the Obon observances, Nene, wife of Toyotomi Hideyoshi, prepared tea with her own hands for her sister-in-law, Lady Asahi, after studying the tea ceremony under Sōeki.

units.source_en: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, during the Obon observances, Nene, wife of Toyotomi Hideyoshi, prepared tea with her own hands for her sister-in-law, Lady Asahi, after studying the tea ceremony under Sōeki.
units.source_zh: 七月十五的盂兰盆会，跟着宗易学过茶道之后，丰臣秀吉的妻子宁宁亲手端茶给小姑子朝日姬。

paragraphs.source_zh: 七月十五的盂兰盆会，跟着宗易学过茶道之后，丰臣秀吉的妻子宁宁亲手端茶给小姑子朝日姬。

paragraphs.source_en: After Saji Hyūga-no-kami Hidemasa died, Lady Asahi remained unable to reconcile herself to the loss, while Nene continually consoled and reasoned with her in a motherly tone. Nene told her that no amount of grief could restore the dead; she ought to look at matters differently, change her frame of mind, and live cheerfully as the Kampaku's sister.

units.source_en: After Saji Hyūga-no-kami Hidemasa died, Lady Asahi remained unable to reconcile herself to the loss, while Nene continually consoled and reasoned with her in a motherly tone.
units.source_zh: 佐治日向守秀正死后，朝日姬始终未能释怀，而宁宁以母亲般的口吻不断地劝说和开导她。

units.source_en: Nene told her that no amount of grief could restore the dead; she ought to look at matters differently, change her frame of mind, and live cheerfully as the Kampaku's sister.
units.source_zh: 宁宁说，不论怎么哀伤，人死不能复生，不如想开点，改变心态，以关白之妹的身份愉快地活下去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 佐治日向守秀正死后，朝日姬始终未能释怀，而宁宁以母亲般的口吻不断地劝说和开导她。宁宁说，不论怎么哀伤，人死不能复生，不如想开点，改变心态，以关白之妹的身份愉快地活下去。

paragraphs.source_en: Nene was thirty-eight that year, while the perpetually despondent Lady Asahi was five years her senior. Yet when Nene counseled her, the difference in their ages never made their exchange seem incongruous. She had married the twenty-six-year-old Hideyoshi when she was fourteen, and ever since had treated Asahi, though older than herself, as a sister-in-law under her care.

paragraphs.source_en: The one offering counsel was the most fortunate woman in the world; the one receiving it was a widow sunk in the deepest misfortune. Though a gulf divided their circumstances, Nene had no choice but to persuade her. This was not selfishness. She was fulfilling her duty as an elder brother's wife, lest her pitiable sister-in-law fall into an abyss beyond salvation.

paragraphs.source_en: The world regarded Hideyoshi as a master of political manipulation, but Nene firmly rejected that judgment.
